crossRefs.note: Each one went straight forward: where the spirit was to go, they went. They didn’t turn when they went.
The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,
When they stood, these stood. When they mounted up, these mounted up with them; for the spirit of the living creature…
Again I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, four chariots came out from between two mountains; and the mountains…

translations.web: Wherever the spirit was to go, they went. The spirit was to go there. The wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
translations.bsb: Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, and the wheels would rise alongside them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.
translations.kjv: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither was their spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
translations.asv: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went; thither was the spirit to go: and the wheels were lifted up beside them; for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
